blocked.title: Viewer blocked for this file
blocked.body: This file is not available through the viewer because it may contain sensitive data.

outside.title: Path is outside the workspace
outside.body: The viewer can only open files that live under the issue's workspace.

archived.title: Workspace is no longer available
archived.body: The isolated worktree for this issue has been cleaned up, so files cannot be previewed.

remote.title: Remote workspace preview not supported
remote.body: This workspace is hosted remotely and is not available for inline preview yet.

tooLarge.title: File is too large to preview
tooLarge.body: This file exceeds the supported preview size.

unsupported.title: Preview not supported for this file type
unsupported.body: This file does not have a text, image, or video preview available.

fallback.title: Can't preview this file
fallback.body: The viewer was unable to load this file.

copy.copyViewLink: Copy link to this file view

browseDescription: Search and preview files from this issue's workspace.

notFound.title: File not found
notFound.body: That file was not found in the active workspace.

noWorkspace.title: No workspace available
noWorkspace.body: This issue does not have a workspace that supports preview yet.

remoteSoon.title: Remote workspace preview coming soon
remoteSoon.body: This workspace is hosted remotely; inline previews are not supported yet.
